title: QoS overrides for recording and playback
keywords: bag rosbag2 qos override qos-profile-overrides-path playback durability transient_local reliability
text: ros2 bag record and ros2 bag play accept --qos-profile-overrides-path with a YAML file that sets QoS per topic. Use it when the defaults do not match: for example play /map with transient-local durability so an RViz started later still gets the map, or record a best-effort sensor topic with best-effort reliability so the recorder matches the publisher.
